title: Segregated solutions for a critical Choquard system with a small interspecies repulsive force
summary: In this work, I focus on a coupled system of nonlinear Choquard equations in dimension 4, characterized by critical nonlocal nonlinearities and a small repulsive interspecies interaction. I prove the existence of a new class of multi-bubble segregated solutions. Specifically, I construct solutions where the first component concentrates as a radial positive ground state, while the second component exhibits a blow-up behaviour, concentrating at k points arranged as the vertices of a regular polygon.
